## feature pairs and labels

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
```

Using anchor feature pair



```{r}
# step 1:  Create the object
eicData_obj <- new("EICData",
           features = result_PA14_FT_filtered,
           eic_data = result_PA14[[4]])

# step 2: Process EICs using Rcpp
eic_obj <- feature_EIC_process(eicData_obj, nrows = nrow(result_PA14_FT_filtered), ncols = 24)


```


```{r}

# step 3: Compute pairwise EIC peak shape correlations:
system.time({
  eic_result <- eicCorrelation(
    object = eic_obj,             #  EICData object
    feature_pairs =  feature_pairs,
    rt_EIC_thr = 3.0,
    method = "pearson"
  )
})
```



## sample intensity correlation

Stm16_corintensity <- CorIntensityPair(feature_table = result_PA14_FT_filtered, feature_pairs = pairs_for_ml,intensity_cols = 13:21)
